items.title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech
items.summary: Helix said that its voice ID tech can run on an iPhone 13
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
items.summary: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.
items.creator: Julie Bort
